observableStateContract.currentAuthority: Foundation schedule plus server room-proximity check
observableStateContract.referenceStatus: Entry trigger is not verified by the supplied sampled observations.
acceptance: One Foundation schedule remains the sole day/period authority.
A player cannot start a second class while one class is active.
Class availability is server-derived and does not create a client-side session authority.
Future implementation must show an observable transition from roam or room presence into the selected activity.
Entry must bind to the current authoritative period and room.
Re-entry to the same active session is idempotent; entry to another session is rejected.

observableStateContract.currentAuthority: ClassSessionController owns ephemeral activity state only

acceptance: First parity activity should be a bounded observable in-world gym/ball interaction, not additional custom curriculum.
The activity presents a clear playable objective and immediate observable response to player actions.
Do not assert exact scoring values or formulas until timestamped temporal evidence exists.
The compact free-roam HUD must not obscure the active-play area or required controls.

observableStateContract.currentAuthority: Server class activity semantics; client presentation is read-only
acceptance: Feedback must distinguish active play from a successful or unsuccessful event without exposing hidden answer or score authority to the client.
Duplicate input identifiers cannot award progress twice.
Any displayed score is a server-returned presentation value.

observableStateContract.currentAuthority: ClassProgressionCoordinator gates return until ProgressionBinding commits exactly once
acceptance: Completion emits once for the authoritative session.
A failed durable progression commit holds the player in a pending state and does not falsely release or reward.
Retry of the same completion reuses the existing receipt and cannot duplicate progression.

observableStateContract.currentAuthority: ClassSessionController.leave or a committed completion response
acceptance: Completion, period change, session end or explicit leave clears the single ephemeral activity session.
Return-to-roam restores the compact edge HUD and movement/camera access.
Leaving an incomplete activity does not fabricate completion or durable reward.
